headline: Gold rises ₹322 per gram today; silver jumps 5% to ₹2,10,000 per kg
summary: Today's change in 24K gold is ₹322 per gram (2.25%) against yesterday's rate, and 22K gold rose ₹295 per gram by the same margin. Silver rose ₹10,000 per kg (5%) today, though it is still ₹5,000 lower than seven days ago and ₹10,000 below its high of ₹2,20,000 on October 26. Within the last 11 days, 24K gold has ranged between ₹13,888 and ₹14,602 per gram, with today's rate at the top of that range. Likely drivers include movements in the US dollar and rupee, and the international spot price, which is currently slightly lower than today's domestic rate.
outlook: Buyers may want to compare today's rate with the price they are quoted, add making charges and GST, and avoid rushing purchases after a single day's jump.
